title: Virtual Supercomputer Builder — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Combines available compute resources into a coordinated environment for suitable parallel workloads. A proposed builder that pools available machines into a virtual supercomputer for workloads that parallelize well: it discovers resources, benchmarks them, partitions the work, coordinates execution, and releases everything cleanly when done. It refuses workloads that would not actually benefit from distribution.
capabilities: Discover and benchmark available compute resources
Release all resources cleanly on completion
